name: AI Usage
author: gotar
description: Opencode Go, Codex/OpenAI (5h session + weekly windows side by side) and Local Qwen 3.8 with live tokens/sec, ctx usage & draft stats — with wallet balance (Zen credits) via a dedicated headless Chromium profile.

barWidget.description: One-screen Opencode Go, Codex and Local Qwen usage with bars, remaining %, wallet balance via Chromium CDP, and a start/stop switch for the local model.

schema.label: Opencode Go API key
schema.description: Paste your Opencode Go API key. Stored in shell.json. Leave blank to use ai-usagebar's opencode-go entry as fallback.

schema.label: Opencode Go endpoint (JSON)
schema.description: JSON usage endpoint. Default is https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage

schema.label: Opencode workspace ID (wallet)
schema.description: Workspace ID for the wallet fetch. Used as https://opencode.ai/workspace/<id>/billing. Uses a dedicated headless Chromium profile — run scripts/opencode-balance.sh --login once to sign in.

schema.label: Wallet cache TTL (seconds)
schema.description: Cache for wallet fetch; browser tab is only opened after TTL expires. Default 600s.

schema.label: Show usage value in bar
schema.description: Show percentages next to the icon in the top bar.

schema.label: Local model systemd unit
schema.description: systemd --user unit for llama.cpp server. Default llama-cpp-server.service

schema.label: Local model host
schema.description: Host:port for the llama.cpp server (display only).
